page.overview:
What is Blood Legion?

Its fortress-monastery is on the world of Harkilae IV which is located in the Segmentum Obscurus.

The Blood Legions' Chapter colours are described as being diagonal tiger‐stripes of red and lightning blue.

The Blood Legions' Chapter badge is not listed in current Imperial records.
